reason: Pi 1.5.2 reads before_agent_start prompt additions only from the systemPromptOptions object it passes in (runner.js emitBeforeAgentStart). Returning systemPrompt instead flattens the sectioned prompt and drops other extensions' sections.
Same host contract as above, for the prompt sections.
The catch returns the job report with a 'could not be restarted' note as the tool/wake text; it must not throw because the report would be lost.
The watcher reports a step failure through ctx.ui.notify and keeps polling. Throwing would kill the watcher loop; console.error would corrupt the TUI.

readFileSync and JSON.parse throw for a missing, unreadable or malformed job.json, and neither has a non-throwing form. The catch returns undefined so job listing skips it, the same as a job.json the schema rejects.
process.kill(pid, 0) throws ESRCH or EPERM and is the only liveness probe that needs no child process. The catch returns false (wrapper gone), which the stop logic depends on.
claimWake creates the woken marker with flag wx, which throws EEXIST once the wake was claimed. The catch returns false so each wake is delivered once; no non-throwing exclusive create exists.
readFileSync throws EACCES, EISDIR and similar, with no non-throwing form. The catch returns undefined and discovery skips the file.
existsSync passed, but readdirSync still throws ENOTDIR or EACCES, with no non-throwing form. The catch returns [] (no agents) instead of failing discovery.
statSync throws ENOENT, ENOTDIR, EACCES and ELOOP, while { throwIfNoEntry: false } covers only ENOENT. The catch returns false (not a directory) for all of them.
JSON.parse throws on a non-JSON stdout line and has no non-throwing form. The catch returns { success: false } and the line is ignored while streaming.
The catch swallows every error from statSync, readRange and the onChunk callback, not only ENOENT, so the poll loop never dies on one bad chunk. Narrowing it would change that.

Any failure to start the tmux session, including the synchronous ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE Node throws for a NUL byte in the model-supplied cwd, becomes spawnError, which the subagent tool reports as 'Failed to spawn subagent: <message>'. Without the catch that NUL case throws out of the tool instead, and console.error plus a new Error would change the reported message and add output to Pi's terminal.
JSON.parse throws on a corrupt transcript line and has no non-throwing form. The catch returns undefined so the line is skipped and the fork still starts.

Pi 1.5.2 reads hidden tools only from the systemPromptOptions object it passes to before_agent_start (runner.js emitBeforeAgentStart), the same host contract as the prompt additions in src/prompt.ts. The new array replaces the old one; the host object is the only place the hide can be written.

validateOutputNotificationConfig compiles a RegExp and has no non-throwing form; catching returns the validation message in the /automate status/run checklist instead of crashing the slash command handler.
